# VESTIGIUM | Harmonization data contract

## Global unit and meaning

**Space:** projected 25,000 m equal-area cells in EPSG:6933; the `cell_x` and `cell_y` keys are integer indices generated by the earlier geospatial pipeline, **not WGS84 coordinates**.

**Time:** UTC `year`, `month` of satellite acquisition, **not** local-time month. Date granularity is monthly. This calibration cannot generate point-level timestamps.

**Reference:** one *VIIRS S-NPP-equivalent detected-pixel-count proxy* conditioned on MODIS detections (`MODIS > 0`) in a month/cell. Fractional numbers are expected **counts**, not fabricated point detections. No sensor counts can establish arson, cause, annual number of fire events, or burned hectares.

## `outputs/calibrated_modis_25km_monthly.csv`

| Column | Type / meaning |
|---|---|
| `year`, `month` | UTC time of MODIS records |
| `cell_x`, `cell_y` | Stable equal-area grid keys; join them only with other **25-km EPSG:6933** grid products |
| `center_longitude`, `center_latitude` | EPSG:4326 geographic center of projected cell, for display only |
| `modis_count` | Raw count of MODIS `type=0` detected pixels, >0 by design |
| `modis_sum_frp_mw` | Sum of pixel FRP readings in MW; not cumulative burned energy |
| `modis_day`, `modis_night` | Count of daytime/nighttime pixel detections |
| `snpp_count` | Raw S-NPP pixels in same grid-month (NaN prior to 2012). A zero in an otherwise available month does NOT prove an absence of fire/clear-sky observations |
| `snpp_reported_this_cell_month` | A matching S-NPP positive record exists, not proof of same-day observation |
| `snpp_equivalent_estimate` | Nonnegative, fractional expected S-NPP-like pixel detection count from MODIS-only inputs |
| `method` | Method selected using 2022 validation RMSE; currently expected `ml_poisson_hgbr` |
| `out_of_training_range` | True when MODIS count OR sum FRP exceeds training 99.5th percentile (a simple high-tail warning, not an uncertainty interval) |
| `prediction_role` | `historical_extrapolation`, `partial_reference_year`, `training_overlap`, `validation_year`, or `untouched_test_overlap` |
| `calibration_reference` | `VIIRS_SNPP` |
| `observation_unit` | `satellite_detected_pixel_count_proxy_not_fire_events` |

## `outputs/harmonized_calendar_monthly.csv`

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year`, `month` | UTC calendar |
| `MODIS` | Raw MODIS observed detections |
| `VIIRS_SNPP`, `VIIRS_NOAA20` | Raw separate VIIRS family counts. Blank before each launch, **not zero** |
| `modis_reference_equivalent_proxy` | Monthly nationwide sum of MODIS-positive 25-km modeled proxy |
| `modis_active_cells` | Number of grid cells with MODIS detections this month |
| `model_out_of_domain_cells` | Count flagged beyond training high-tail support |
| `calendar_display_estimate` | Hybrid (model backcast 2000–2011, S-NPP observed 2012+), **structural discontinuity**; do not interpret changes across 2012 causally |
| `calendar_method` | Source/method provenance |
| `cross_2012_discontinuity_warning` | Always true to warn cross-instrument handoff |
| `missing_observation_coverage_unknown` | Always true because upstream active-fire detections lack observed clear-sky opportunity denominators |

## `outputs/harmonized_calendar_annual.csv`

Above monthly series summed annually; `incomplete_year` true for 2000, where only Nov–Dec are present. NOAA-20 unavailable prior to 2018; S-NPP unavailable prior to 2012. Do not sum raw sensors as different independent fire events.

## Model and evaluation

`evaluation.json` documents the exact splits, candidate algorithms, scores, training coverage, and omissions. `test_monthly_comparison.csv` is reference values **restricted to MODIS-positive grid-months**, while the raw S-NPP column of `harmonized_calendar_monthly.csv` includes all S-NPP-positive grid-months. Mixing these denominators will generate incorrect metrics.

## UI safety labels

Suggested: `Satellite hotspot detection`, `Estimated satellite detection activity`, `Experimental calibration`, `Area requires further investigation`, `Model uncertainty not quantified`.

Avoid: `Confirmed wildfire`, `Intentional arson`, `Number of separate fires`, `Recovered missed hotspot points`, `Area burned (hectares)` unless corroborating sources and methods are explicitly added.
